shown.message:
I copied the compacted figures from `figtab-repo` into `paper-repo` `dev` (5aa8a3f) and read the system's build of that commit. The main text still ends on page 9, with the Discussion and limitations section about two-thirds down the page and references below it, so the 9-page limit holds. That leaves roughly a third of page 9 free for the recalibrated-estimator results when `experiment-repo` delivers them.

`figtab-repo` had pushed the figures only to its own `main`, so I copied them myself. `figures/` is `figtab-repo`'s path in `CODEOWNERS`, but they had asked me to re-copy.

`paper-repo`#5 is unchanged. It was opened from an earlier commit and still waits on reviews from `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo`. I didn't check whether it includes the new figures. I also haven't sent a request to `experiment-repo`: `experiment-repo`#7 and #8 are still open, and the recalibrated-estimator results aren't delivered.
